findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "market_data" appears informational but accepts parameters (command) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: action, command, coin, exchange, tf, limit, indicators, columns, inline_indicators

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "alert_manager" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: system_docs, alert_manager, user_account, send_notification · Private data: system_docs, market_data, alert_manager, user_account · Public sink: system_docs, send_notification.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: system_docs, alert_manager, user_account, send_notification · Private data: system_docs, market_data, alert_manager, user_account · Public sink: system_docs, send_notification

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
